rules.title: Fabric mod missing a required dependency
rules.advice: Fabric mods declare dependencies on each other. The error usually lists the missing mod (`requires fabric-api`, `requires cloth-config`, …). Install the missing mod and matching version into your `mods/` folder, or remove the dependent mod.

rules.title: Duplicate mod jar
patterns: Found duplicate mods loaded from files
rules.advice: Two jars in `mods/` declare the same mod id. Delete the older version. Run-of-the-mill cause: a leftover `Sodium-0.5.3.jar` next to a freshly-downloaded `Sodium-0.5.8.jar`.

rules.title: Mod jar is corrupted or partially downloaded
patterns: Could not find or load main class.*from jar
rules.advice: One of the jars in `mods/`, `coremods/`, or the loader itself is corrupted. The launcher log usually names it on the previous line. Re-download just that file, or delete the `libraries/` folder and let MeshMC re-fetch.

rules.title: Mixin transform failed
rules.advice: Two mods are trying to rewrite the same class in incompatible ways. The Mixin name in the error (`Mixin{...}`) tells you which mod's transformer failed — disable it and the conflict source one at a time. A common pair: Sodium + a too-new Lithium build.
